title: Final Answer for (i)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the beam polarized along +z is not split but its direction is changed.

title: Final Answer for (ii)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must indicate that the beam polarized along +x splits into two beams, one deflected to +z and the other to -z.

title: Final Answer for (iii)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must mention that the beam polarized along +y splits into two beams, similar to the +x case.

title: Final Answer for (iv)
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the unpolarized beam splits into two beams, one deflected to +z and the other to -z.

title: Distinguishing Method
description: Important Criteria: The response must describe how to distinguish between the cases using the magnetic field direction or a reflector.

title: Indistinguishable Cases
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly identify which cases are indistinguishable based on the results.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid incorrect signs in the description of deflections or splits.

title: Missing Details
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should not omit any required details about the behavior of the beams.
